title: Zesty Algerian Almond Paste Toast
description: A dense, umami-packed toast featuring almond paste and aromatic spices, sugar‑free and light yet flavorful.
instructions: Heat the kadhai over medium heat and add the olive oil, swirling to coat the pan.
Toast the bread slices in the warm oil until golden brown on both sides, about 1-2 minutes per side.
While the bread is toasting, whisk the almond paste with cumin, paprika, coriander, cayenne, salt, and lemon zest until smooth.
Remove the toasted bread from the kadhai and spread the almond paste mixture evenly over each slice.
Return the toast to the pan and cook for 1 minute, allowing the spices to bloom and the paste to slightly caramelize.
Transfer the toast to a plate, drizzle with a squeeze of lemon juice, and sprinkle chopped parsley on top.
Serve immediately while the toast is warm and fragrant.
